dsh-key-rotation.bulkImportDesc: Paste API keys line-by-line, as .env (KEY=value), or CSV (KEY, weight):
dsh-key-rotation.cardDesc: Per-provider API key rotation: pools of keys, automatic failover on quota/rate-limit errors, cooldown and recovery.
dsh-key-rotation.confirmBulkRemoveDesc: Selected providers and all their keys will be removed from rotation. You can undo once immediately after.
dsh-key-rotation.confirmRemoveProvDesc: Are you sure you want to remove this provider and all configured keys from rotation?
dsh-key-rotation.confirmResetDesc: This will immediately clear all failure counts, cooldown timers, and reset the circuit breaker.
dsh-key-rotation.desc: Per-provider API key rotation. For each provider, list its API keys (env names, stored in DSH credentials). The plugin routes a model through that provider’s keys in order and switches to the next on a quota/rate-limit failure.
dsh-key-rotation.discoverBannerDesc: Found {n} credentials in your environment (~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml / env) not yet assigned to any rotation pool.
dsh-key-rotation.emptyDesc: Add a provider and at least one API key name to start rotating.
dsh-key-rotation.header.sub: Automated multi-key round-robin rotation, 429/5xx exponential backoff cooldowns, circuit breaker failover protection, and credential security (~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml).
dsh-key-rotation.header.title: Key Rotation & Failover
dsh-key-rotation.jsonConfigPlaceholder: Paste JSON configuration here or choose a file...
dsh-key-rotation.keyHint: The value is stored in DSH credentials and never sent back to the browser — only its last 5 characters are shown. Names are generated for you; hover a key to see the one it uses.
dsh-key-rotation.matrixModalDesc: Parallel probe of all configured credentials across all provider pools.
dsh-key-rotation.modelPoolsEmpty: No model sub-pools configured. Add one to give a model its own keys and token budgets.
dsh-key-rotation.modelPoolsHint: Give one credential its own token budget for one model. A key that spends its budget is skipped for that model only — other models keep using it. Leave the limit empty for unlimited.
dsh-key-rotation.mtLocalOnly: Tracked locally from provider-reported usage on successful responses.
dsh-key-rotation.noProviders: No providers registered with DSH — nothing to pick from yet.
dsh-key-rotation.notSecretShape: saved, but the value does not look like an API key - check for a typo
dsh-key-rotation.presetNone: No canonical preset for this provider
dsh-key-rotation.previewSummary: Diff: {created} new providers, {updated} updated providers, {keys} keys ({added} new).
dsh-key-rotation.proactiveGuardHint: Pre-emptively pause keys when remaining quota or Retry-After header indicates limit before hitting 429
dsh-key-rotation.promptCacheDesc: Tokens served from prefix cache across sessions and estimated cost savings.
dsh-key-rotation.quickResetTitle: Reset cooldowns and circuit breaker for active provider
dsh-key-rotation.quickSkipTitle: Skip to next key in pool
dsh-key-rotation.saveRefused: The host did not accept this save. Your draft is kept; discard it to load the latest settings.
dsh-key-rotation.saveUnconfirmed: The save result could not be confirmed. Your draft is kept; reload before trying again.
dsh-key-rotation.sectionBackupDesc: Export or import provider pools and create full plugin configuration snapshots.
dsh-key-rotation.sectionFailoverDesc: Select error conditions that trigger automatic switching to the next available key.
dsh-key-rotation.sectionStatsDesc: Real-time telemetry of active key pools, healthy credentials, and failover status.
dsh-key-rotation.sectionTimingDesc: Configure cooldown durations and scheduled periodic rotation windows.
dsh-key-rotation.selfHealingHint: Periodic free model check to revive broken keys (0 to disable)
dsh-key-rotation.settingsChanged: The settings service changed. Discard this draft and reload before saving.
dsh-key-rotation.showChatHeaderChipDesc: Show pool status chip in conversation header
dsh-key-rotation.simulatorDesc: Test routing strategies and visualize failover trace across key pools without sending real upstream requests.
dsh-key-rotation.simulatorNoResults: Run a simulation to view the candidate execution trace.
dsh-key-rotation.subtitle: Per-provider API key rotation: pools of keys, automatic failover on quota/rate-limit errors, cooldown and recovery.
dsh-key-rotation.title: Key Rotation
dsh-key-rotation.tokenLimitHint: Tokens this credential may spend on this model per quota window. Empty = unlimited.
dsh-key-rotation.unavailableDesc: The host did not expose the dsh-key-rotation settings namespace. Reopen Settings or check the plugin is enabled.
dsh-key-rotation.updateRestart: Update installed. Restart DSH to load the new version.
dsh-key-rotation.weightHint: round-robin weight: how many times this key joins the cycle (1 = equal share)
